description: Labels of the JavaScript and TypeScript candidates of the v0.3 exports of 84 npm sources that are not known vulnerable sites. Criteria: PROTOCOL.md.
assigned_by: AI coding assistant (Claude), reading the package source
reviewed_by: project owner, 2026-11-15: all 84 labels. 31 in an interactive session with the code of each item, 47 in a Markdown review file; 3 of those were decided after the alert start lines were shown from the saved report
review_note: 12 labels differ from what the assistant assigned (_thi.ng__egf_0.3.0|lib/index.umd.js|U1; git-parse_1.0.4|dist/checkout_commit.js|U10; git-parse_1.0.4|dist/git_diff.js|U10; git-parse_1.0.4|dist/git_log_stream.js|U8; git-parse_1.0.4|dist/git_pull.js|U10; launch-editor_2.14.1|index.js|167; launch-editor_2.14.1|index.js|172; monorepo-build_0.1.9|lib/index.test.js|12; nodemon_3.1.14|lib/monitor/run.js|430; nodemon_3.1.14|lib/monitor/run.js|434; react-dev-utils_11.0.0|openBrowser.js|92; roar-pidusage_1.1.6|lib/helpers.js|12). The reviewer labels an alert on a require line by the command calls of that module, and counts each unmatched alert as its own unit at the line it starts on, which split one label of extra-asciinema into seven. CVE identifiers and source links in the notes are the reviewer's.

labels.label: vulnerable
labels.reason: `body` of a #gpg tag comes from the parsed EGF text and is put inside `echo "${body}" | gpg --decrypt`.

review.note: Trong nhánh giải mã của Node.js, nội dung thẻ GPG do bên gọi cung cấp được ghép vào chuỗi cho `execSync` bằng dấu ngoặc kép mà không có bước trích dẫn phù hợp. [Tài liệu gói](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40thi.ng/egf)

labels.label: vulnerable
labels.reason: The alert points at `require("child_process")` in the minified bundle; that expression runs no command.

review.note: VULNERABLE - Confirmed command injection. Although ESLint reports the require("child_process") expression rather than the execution sink, the same bundled module contains execSync() with untrusted #gpg content interpolated into a shell command. The vulnerability corresponds to the known vulnerable implementation in tags.js:25. Classify as a true positive at the module-level alert scope.

labels.label: vulnerable
labels.reason: Each `ip` of the `range` argument of the public `arp()` is interpolated into the shell command string without quoting or validation.

review.note: Hàm công khai `arp` nhận `range` từ bên gọi và ghép từng `ip` vào chuỗi cho `child_process.exec` sau khi kiểm tra kiểu của `range`. [Mã nguồn 2.0.0](https://github.com/haf-decent/arpping/blob/503cb320cd54c719bca88fea22a2c5b3a5ebddfe/index.js#L135-L148) · [Điểm xuất](https://github.com/haf-decent/arpping/blob/503cb320cd54c719bca88fea22a2c5b3a5ebddfe/index.js#L222)

labels.label: safe
labels.reason: `ipCommand` is set once at module load to 'ipconfig' or 'ifconfig' depending on the platform.

review.note: SAFE - Constant command. ipCommand chỉ được gán các giá trị cố định ipconfig hoặc ifconfig dựa trên hệ điều hành. Không phát hiện dữ liệu không tin cậy truyền vào exec() tại vị trí cảnh báo. Đây là false positive đối với command injection, mặc dù package có lỗ hổng tại các vị trí khác.

labels.label: vulnerable
labels.reason: `path.basename(file)` and `args`, both arguments of the blame function, are concatenated into `svn blame`.

review.note: Nhánh SVN của `Blamer.blameByFile` chuyển `file` và `args` từ bên gọi vào hàm ghép lệnh, nơi `path.basename(file)` và `args` dạng chuỗi đi thẳng vào `exec`. [API công khai](https://github.com/kucherenko/blamer/blob/347e365e8d62c69099de57c46a0e717446b76e74/src/Blamer.js#L10-L15) · [Mã nguồn 0.1.13](https://github.com/kucherenko/blamer/blob/347e365e8d62c69099de57c46a0e717446b76e74/src/vcs/svn.js#L7-L41)

labels.label: vulnerable
labels.reason: `root` is `path.resolve(args.options.root || query.root || '.')`, a command-line option, concatenated into `find`.

review.note: `root` lấy từ tùy chọn của bên gọi, được chuẩn hóa bằng `path.resolve` rồi ghép trực tiếp vào chuỗi cho `execSync` ở nhánh tìm báo cáo ngoài Windows. [Tùy chọn dòng lệnh](https://github.com/codecov/codecov-node/blob/bac0787351100cb430a72cfe58e46f0cdb069da5/bin/codecov#L9-L11) · [Gán `root`](https://github.com/codecov/codecov-node/blob/bac0787351100cb430a72cfe58e46f0cdb069da5/lib/codecov.js#L356) · [Thực thi](https://github.com/codecov/codecov-node/blob/bac0787351100cb430a72cfe58e46f0cdb069da5/lib/codecov.js#L480)

labels.label: vulnerable
labels.reason: Unmatched alert on line 356 about the same `root` value reaching the shell commands on lines 419 and 480.

review.note: First pass (review file): Lý do cũ nêu dòng 356, nơi gán `root`, và hai điểm thực thi tại 419 và 480. Nhật ký cảnh báo gốc cần xác nhận dòng bắt đầu và liệu mục này có trùng mục 4 tại dòng 480 hay là ứng viên riêng. [Mã nguồn 3.6.4](https://github.com/codecov/codecov-node/blob/bac0787351100cb430a72cfe58e46f0cdb069da5/lib/codecov.js#L356-L480) Second pass (alert start lines shown from the saved report): Label case 5 as vulnerable and count it as one separate candidate. The CodeQL alert starts at lib/codecov.js:356:27. path.resolve normalizes the externally supplied root but does not escape shell metacharacters before the value reaches the shell commands at lines 419 and 480. Those lines are related locations with their own candidate records.

labels.label: undetermined
labels.reason: `spawn(command, args, options)` runs the caller's program without a shell unless the caller's options ask for one; the API exists to run what the caller passes.

review.note: UNCERTAIN - Caller-controlled process execution. The package invokes child_process.spawn(command, args, options) with caller-supplied arguments. Although spawn does not use a shell by default, callers may enable options.shell, potentially exposing untrusted input to shell interpretation. The API intentionally supports arbitrary program execution, and no specific untrusted-to-sink exploit path has been established. Exploitability depends on caller context and trust boundaries.

labels.label: vulnerable

review.note: Hàm công khai `update` nhúng khóa và giá trị từ `options.cmdOptions` do bên gọi truyền vào `cmd` trước khi đưa chuỗi đến `exec`, qua bước kiểm tra giá trị có tồn tại. labels.label: vulnerable
labels.reason: Both callers of `getconf` in the package pass the literals 'CLK_TCK' and 'PAGESIZE'.

review.note: VULNERABLE - OS Command Injection. The exported getconf() function concatenates its keyword parameter directly into a shell command executed via child_process.exec(), without validation or escaping. Although both internal callers pass constant values (CLK_TCK and PAGESIZE), external consumers can invoke the exported function with attacker-controlled input. Shell metacharacters can therefore reach the execution sink.
